headline: Lufthansa Q3 Results Meet Expectations Despite High Fuel Costs
summary: Lufthansa reported third-quarter results that met market expectations, though performance was constrained by high jet fuel expenses.
why: Airlines are highly sensitive to fluctuating jet fuel expenses, making earnings reports a key indicator of margin pressures within the global aviation sector.

impacts.name: Lufthansa
impacts.why: Results meeting expectations offset headwinds from high fuel costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
